summary: Iteration 93: Regression tests for POS return ledger attribution fix. Verified purchase earn + return reversal write ledger rows with customer_mobile, RET- bill_number, ledger_kind='return'. Core regression (ledger query by customer_mobile ONLY missing return row) is FIXED. All 6 pytest cases pass. Cleanup executed (test customer/mobile/transactions/ledger deleted).

minor.issue: recent_transactions projection for the RET- bill omits is_return:true flag (uses return_marker:'Return' instead, and points_earned is negative). The customer-360-by-id endpoint returns is_return:true. Frontend depending on is_return flag might not render the RETURN pill consistently across the two endpoints.

points_ledger projection omits ledger_kind field (returns type='adjust' only). The DB row correctly has ledger_kind='return' and customer-360-by-id endpoint returns it. Minor inconsistency between the two ledger projections.

Consider including ledger_kind in customer-by-mobile points_ledger projection for parity with customer-360-by-id.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix is verified. Return ledger row now has customer_mobile, bill_number='RET-<orig>', ledger_kind='return', negative points. The customer-360 by-id ($or) and by-mobile (mobile-only) endpoints both surface the return row, timeline, and recent_transactions. rca of the issue: RCA: return_order() previously inserted the reversal points_ledger row with only customer_id and no customer_mobile/bill_number/ledger_kind. Any read that filtered points_ledger by customer_mobile alone (e.g. /api/dashboard/customer-by-mobile) therefore returned 0 return rows, making the RETURN invisible on Customer 360 Earn·burn timeline and yielding a stale/incorrect points_balance display. Fix (validated): return_order at ~line 2199-2245 now writes return_bill_number ('RET-<orig>-<short>') once and inserts points_ledger with {customer_mobile, customer_id, bill_number:return_bill_number, ledger_kind:'return', original_bill_number, points:<negative>}. Mitigation for historic prod row (9899533604): main agent should run a one-off backfill to set customer_mobile/bill_number/ledger_kind on the orphaned return ledger row(s).
